name: woocommerce/orders-query
label: Query orders
description: Find orders by ID or common order filters.

name: woocommerce/order-add-note
label: Add order note
description: Add a note to an order.

name: woocommerce/order-notes-query
label: Query order notes
description: List every note of an order, newest first.

name: woocommerce/order-send-email
label: Send order email
description: Send an order email to the customer again.

name: woocommerce/order-update
label: Update order
description: Update the addresses, customer note, product lines and shipping lines of an order. Fields that are not sent keep their value. Changing lines recalculates the totals and needs an order status that allows editing. Use the woocommerce/order-update-status ability to change the status.

name: woocommerce/payment-gateways-query
label: Query payment gateways
description: List the payment gateways in checkout order, enabled or not, or get one by ID.

name: woocommerce/products-query
label: Query products
description: Find products by ID or common catalog filters.

name: woocommerce/product-terms-query
label: Query product terms
description: Find product categories, tags or brands. Use include to retrieve specific term IDs.

name: woocommerce/product-create
label: Create product
description: Create a product using supported catalog fields.

name: woocommerce/product-delete
label: Delete product
description: Delete, trash, or restore a product.

name: woocommerce/product-update
label: Update product
description: Update an existing product using supported catalog fields.
